result.summary: Found 1 major layout issue where text elements overlap on a restaurant card.

issues.description: In the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card under 'Popular right now', the delivery time text '25-30' is overlapping with the word 'delivery', making it illegible.
issues.suggestion: Fix the container layout or add appropriate spacing/margin between the time estimate and the delivery text so they display sequentially without overlapping.
